g.text: Each cell is one year; shading shows the number of orbital launch attempts (log scale). Dotted lines: Sputnik 1957, Apollo 11 1969,
first Shuttle 1981, first Falcon 9 landing 2015. Data: GCAT (J. McDowell, CC-BY 4.0), launches to 13 Oct 2026.
